title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
abstract: arXiv:2609.36797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. translated_title: 随机性在神经元胞自动机中的何处发挥作用？
translated_abstract: 随机细胞更新在神经元胞自动机（NCA）的整个生命周期中被广泛使用，从时间反向传播到最终展开（rollout）。这使得两个问题纠缠在一起：更新随机性是否有助于学习一个有用的规则？该随机性是否必须在执行阶段保留？我们在受控的生长型NCA（Growing NCA）实验中分离了训练与评估的更新模式，并改变训练期间呈现的状态。在标准的恒定速率持续（constant-rate persist）配方下，异步训练在10/10次运行中通过了短时程质量测试，而同步训练仅有3/10次通过。所有十个异步模型在确定性评估下仍能保持目标状态达4,096步。对于一个标量平移不变晶格，我们推导出一个精确的均方准则：随机掩蔽可以阻尼均值模式，但同时也会注入方差，而仅基于均值的测试会错误分类四个非边际设置。最后，在30个全部通过相同重建[测试的模型中……]（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将NCA中随机性的作用拆分为训练与执行两个阶段，证明异步随机更新对学习稳定的生长规则至关重要（10/10对3/10的成功率），但在执行时可以完全移除（确定性评估下仍能保持目标4,096步），并为标量平移不变晶格推导出判断随机掩蔽利弊的精确均方准则。
en_tdlr: This work disentangles the roles of randomness during training versus execution in neural cellular automata, showing that stochastic asynchronous updates are essential for learning robust growing rules but can be removed at inference time, and derives an exact mean-square criterion for when random masking helps or harms on translation-invariant lattices.
